name: Groove
description: Groove is a shared-inbox and customer-support platform for managing email conversations, assignments, knowledge, reporting, and service workflows. Support teams use it to collaborate on customer requests and keep service work organized in one place.
agentUseSummary: Enter your Groove API token once, then let agents inspect the connected account, read channels, or use the complete token-authorized GraphQL API under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: GROOVE_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Groove API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy an API token from Groove Settings > Organization > API. Its access follows the connected Groove account.

capabilities.label: Read account details
capabilities.description: Verify and read the exact Groove account bound to this connection.

capabilities.label: Read support channels
capabilities.description: List a bounded page of channels from the connected Groove account.

capabilities.label: Full Groove API
capabilities.description: Use the complete current Groove GraphQL API surface authorized by the connected token.

allowed.label: Read account
allowed.description: Read the identity and state of the connected Groove account.

allowed.label: List channels
allowed.description: List one bounded page of support channels from the connected Groove account.

approvalRequired.label: Use full Groove API
approvalRequired.description: Run a documented Groove GraphQL query or mutation authorized by the connected token; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Account and bounded channel reads run directly; every other Groove GraphQL operation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected token-authorized Groove operation runs without Relay per-action approval; exact account binding, secret isolation, request bounds, audits, provider authority, and Groove limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: The backend mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted customer token only to the exact Groove account.
The backend mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted customer token only to the exact Groove account.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer-owned Groove API token is required for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer enters an API token, then Relay verifies the exact account, bounded reads, Safe approval, Dangerous mutation, token reset, and disconnect behavior.

evidence.supports: Groove documents the current GraphQL v2 endpoint, bearer authentication, and customer-generated API tokens from Settings > Organization > API.
Groove documents account, channels, and the broader query surface exposed by the current GraphQL schema.
Groove documents the current GraphQL mutation surface authorized by the connected account token.
Groove's legacy REST v1 OAuth page does not define a complete current refresh, revocation, and account-binding lifecycle, so Relay does not present it as a shared OAuth connection.
